summary: Arcee's Trinity Builders Program offers free Trinity API credits to approved applicants, allocated at review based on project scope and available capacity. Application request ranges run from under 50M to over 1B tokens; they are requests, not guaranteed awards. Arcee may award partial grants or decline applications. Awarded credits expire 90 days from the date of allocation, not on a global program end date.
claim_steps: Apply through the official form linked from Arcee's Trinity Builders Program article and explain the project and requested token range.
Wait for rolling review, with no fixed timeline; approval and the requested allocation are not guaranteed and depend on capacity and project scope.
If approved, use the allocated Trinity API credits within 90 days from the date of allocation.

social_proof.title: Introducing the Trinity Builders Program | Arcee AI | Building Open Intelligence
social_proof.text: Accepted applicants receive free API credits for Trinity models, allocated based on your project scope and our available capacity. Actual allocations, if approved, are determined at review time. Awarded credits are valid for 90 days from the date of allocation, subject to the program terms below.
